output.reason: The release note alone is vague [ev-f810dce8b260], but the linked PR fills the gap. It says the change adds a new parameter, `BearerToken`, to use when Bearer auth is needed instead of Basic auth, for example a BitBucket Project token [ev-c9f34cec9d2e]. The changed files show where it lives: the repository credential type (repository_types.go, generated.proto) and the `argocd repo add`, `argocd repocreds add` and `admin repo generate-spec` commands [ev-70dd893b1d3f]. That is enough to write the assertion: the subject is the new repository/repo-creds `BearerToken` field, the change is that it was added, only users who choose to set it are exposed, and an operator who does nothing sees no change, since Basic auth stays the alternative.
